answer: Require a fixed refundable bond for each agent receiving rewards, and lock it through a challenge window. A signed receipt must anchor each reward to one unique task outcome; replayed receipts earn nothing. An identity garden then ties up capital for every extra account instead of creating a free reward spiral. Slash only proven double claims under a published appeal rule. This raises the cost of account splitting, but wealthy attackers can still buy many identities; it is friction, not proof of personhood.
